title: Bound Engram module test parallelism in developer commands
outcome: Supplemental command cargo test tests::engram_host_adapter --no-fail-fast ran 157 FD/process-heavy tests at default parallelism and failed 9 tests through 2s gate timeouts followed by a poisoned shared kill-failure mutex. Each first-failure test passed with --exact immediately afterward. Classification: environment/resource issue caused by bypassing scripts/test-rust.sh, whose purpose is to bound Rust test parallelism and raise FD limits. Next action: use scripts/test-rust.sh as the authoritative gate; add or document a bounded module-test helper if direct Engram-module runs remain part of development workflow.
